name: Tabs
description: Tabs switch between related views of content in the same place, one at a time. Tabs holds the state, TabList the row of Tab buttons, and each TabPanel the content for one tab.
whenToUse: To organize related content into views people switch between without leaving the page.
To filter one list by category, e.g. All / Electronics / Accessories.

whenNotToUse.text: For content people need to compare side by side.

anatomy.name: Tab list
anatomy.description: The row of tabs; enclosed tabs sit in a tinted container.

anatomy.name: Selected tab
anatomy.description: The tab whose panel is showing.

anatomy.name: Tab
anatomy.description: A label, optionally with an icon.

anatomy.name: Panel
anatomy.description: The content for the selected tab.

values.meaning: Tabs in a tinted container. Compact filters and toolbars.
Filled pill on the selected tab, no container. Light filtering inside cards.
Underline under the selected tab. Page-level sections.
Tabs in a row above the panel. Default.
Tabs in a column beside the panel, e.g. settings with many sections. A row again on narrow screens.

states.name: Hover
states.meaning: Shows the tab responds to the pointer.

behavior.text: The tab list is one Tab stop. Arrow keys move between tabs and select them; Home and End jump to the first and last; Tab moves into the panel.
When tabs filter one list, render a single TabPanel with value set to the selected tab.
Tabs wrap onto a new line when they don’t fit; keep labels short and the number of tabs small.
Tab order and arrow keys follow the reading direction in Arabic.

content: Use one or two words per tab, in sentence case.
Label the tab list with what it switches between, e.g. "Product categories".
Keep the order stable; don’t reorder tabs based on use.

guidelines.do: Use tabs for peer views of the same subject.
guidelines.why: Tabs change content in place; links belong in navigation.

guidelines.do: Keep to a handful of short tabs.
guidelines.dont: Squeeze in many tabs with long labels.
guidelines.why: Too many tabs wrap and become hard to scan; consider a Select instead.

guidelines.do: Select a sensible tab by default.
guidelines.why: A panel should always be visible so the page isn’t empty.

accessibility.role: tablist with tab buttons and tabpanel regions (Radix Tabs).

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the selected tab, then into the panel.
Moves to and selects the previous or next tab.
Moves to the first or last tab.

aria.when: Link each tab and its panel.

accessibility.focus: Tabs and the panel show the focus ring when reached with the keyboard.

wcag.how: Tabs and panels are linked; the list is labelled.
Tab labels pass 4.5:1 in every state and theme.
Arrow keys, Home and End as in the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern.
Exposed as tabs with their selected state.

notes: Selected tabs are shown with color and a heavier weight (and an underline in the line appearance), not color alone.

examples.title: Sections of a page
examples.description: Line tabs with a panel per tab.
examples.code:
import { Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel } from '@ds/react';

<Tabs defaultValue="overview" appearance="line">
  <TabList label="Project">
    <Tab value="overview">Overview</Tab>
    <Tab value="activity">Activity</Tab>
    <Tab value="settings">Settings</Tab>
  </TabList>
  <TabPanel value="overview">…</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel value="activity">…</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel value="settings">…</TabPanel>
</Tabs>

examples.title: Filtering one list
examples.description: One panel shows the list for the selected tab.
examples.code:
import { Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel } from '@ds/react';

<Tabs value={category} onValueChange={setCategory}>
  <TabList label="Product categories">
    <Tab value="all">All</Tab>
    <Tab value="electronics">Electronics</Tab>
  </TabList>
  <TabPanel value={category}>
    <ProductGrid category={category} />
  </TabPanel>
</Tabs>

examples.title: With icons
examples.code:
import { Tabs, TabList, Tab } from '@ds/react';
import { LayoutGrid, Laptop } from 'lucide-react';

<Tabs defaultValue="all" appearance="pill">
  <TabList label="Categories">
    <Tab value="all" icon={<LayoutGrid />}>All</Tab>
    <Tab value="electronics" icon={<Laptop />}>Electronics</Tab>
  </TabList>
</Tabs>

related.relation: Use to choose a form value.

changes: Compound API (Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel) on Radix with keyboard navigation and linked panels.
Appearances enclosed, pill and line; icons as React nodes; tokens renamed from --tap-* to --tabs-*.
Line tabs: thin neutral baseline, so only the selected tab is underlined in the accent color.

components.name: Tabs
components.description:
Switches between related views of content in the same place. Only one panel shows at a
time. Arrow keys move between tabs.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new tab's value.

appearance.description:
`enclosed` (default): tabs in a tinted container, for compact filters and toolbars.
`pill`: filled pill on the selected tab, no container. `line`: underline, for page sections.

orientation.description:
`horizontal` (default): tabs in a row above the panel. `vertical`: tabs stacked in a
column beside the panel, for settings pages with many sections; Up and Down arrows move
between tabs. On narrow screens vertical tabs sit above the panel.

label.description: What the tabs switch between, e.g. "Product categories". Announced with the tab list.

value.description: Matches the TabPanel this tab shows.

icon.description: Icon before the label. Hidden from screen readers.

components.name: TabPanel
components.description: Content shown while its tab is selected.

value.description: The tab value this panel belongs to.
